title: WID Generation Bounds Test Cases
description: Canonical-mode generation (A=next) MUST reject out-of-range or non-integer W/Z (SPEC.md, Parameters) and accept boundary values; accepted output must round-trip through the same implementation's validate. Consumed by tools/check_id_conformance.py.

test_cases.description: W=18 is the maximum valid width
W=1 and Z=64 are the remaining valid extremes
W=19 would overflow an int64 sequence
W=25 must be rejected, not emitted
W=0 is below the minimum width
Z=65 exceeds the maximum padding length
Z=100 must be rejected, not emitted as 100 hex chars
non-integer W must be a clean error (never evaluated as arithmetic)
